comparison_findings: The comparator has a distinct input contract: two already assembled ContextPacket R0 outputs bound to the same caller-declared question, current_ref, and ordered obligations.
No compared tool provides the same paired structural byte and obligation delta output.

This is contract-level specialization evidence only; semantic relevance, important-error recall, answer quality, task outcome, provider token use, billing, retrieval cost, and sufficiency remain unmeasured.
